context_card.cerita: Nenek memasak rendang untuk lomba masak RT besok, lalu pukul 17.00 pancinya dipindah keluar dapur supaya cepat dingin. Pukul 21.00 rendangnya mendadak asam! Salah satu tersangka berbohong.

clue_awal.teks: Gula hanya ada di dapur. Kalau pakai gula, sabotasenya pasti dilakukan di Dapur.

pengakuan.teks: Aku tidak ke teras sama sekali malam ini.
Aku tidak menyentuh garam. Kukuku baru dicat.
Aku tidak mengambil gula. Kopiku malam ini pahit.
Aku tidak menyentuh botol kecap, sumpah demi followers.
Aku tidak masuk kamar Ibu malam ini.

tk_meja.teks: Ada bekas lingkaran panci di meja teras. Panci rendang didinginkan di sini sejak 17.00 sampai diambil Nenek.

dp_laci.teks: Di laci bumbu, bungkus garam masih rapat dilakban. Belum dibuka sama sekali.

dp_kulkas.teks: Botol kecap di pintu kulkas masih tersegel plastik. Kecap yang lain sudah habis sejak minggu lalu.

rk_meja.teks: Semua sachet cabai bubuk dari tukang bakso masih utuh di meja kerja. Tidak ada satu pun yang terbuka.

kn_ranjang.teks: Seprai dan lantai kamar bersih. Tidak ada bau rendang sama sekali; panci tidak pernah masuk ke sini.

dp_kompor.teks: Kompor sudah dingin sejak sore. Panci rendang jelas tidak kembali ke dapur sebelum 21.00.

rt_meja.teks: Meja kopi penuh piring kue tamu arisan. Panci rendang tak pernah mampir ke ruang tamu.

rk_papan.teks: Tulisan di papan: "Rapat RT 18.00–21.00." Ruang Kerja penuh bapak-bapak, tidak ada panci di sini.

tk_kursi.teks: Kipas lipat bermotif bunga tertinggal di kursi rotan. Baunya seperti cuka.

tk_sampah.teks: Bak sampah teras berisi daun belimbing. Banyak sekali daun belimbing.

tk_kandang.teks: Ayam-ayam Pak Joko menatapmu. Mereka tidak akan bicara.

dp_toples.teks: Toples kerupuk penuh. Ada uang lipatan di dasarnya, tapi itu urusan Mbok Sri.

dp_wastafel.teks: Wastafel bersih. Spons cuci piring sudah setipis rahasia keluarga.

kn_weker.teks: Jam weker disetel pukul 04.00. Nenek mau ke pasar sebelum lomba.

rk_komputer.teks: Layar menampilkan slide rapat RT: "Anggaran Lomba 17-an". Membosankan, tapi bersih.

rt_foto.teks: Foto Nenek memegang piala lomba rendang tahun lalu. Senyumnya penuh percaya diri.

teks_kosong_bawaan: Kamu memeriksanya dengan teliti, tapi tidak ada yang mencurigakan.

penjelasan.teks: Pembohongnya selalu pelaku. Jadi kalau seseorang pelakunya, pengakuannya pasti salah: Bu Wati di teras, Tante Lia pakai garam, Dimas pakai gula, Raka pakai kecap, Om Benny di kamar Nenek.
Panci rendang didinginkan di meja teras: sabotasenya terjadi di Teras.
Garam, kecap, dan cabai bubuk tidak tersentuh. Gula hanya bisa dipakai di dapur. Yang tersisa: cuka.
Cuka di teras hanya cocok dengan satu pembohong: Bu Wati, yang mengaku tidak ke teras.

komentar_nenek: Wati, kalau mau menang lomba, masak yang enak. Jangan rendang Nenek yang dikasih cuka.

en.cerita: Grandma cooked rendang for tomorrow's neighborhood cooking contest, and at 5:00 p.m. the pot was moved out of the kitchen to cool. At 9:00 p.m. the rendang suddenly tasted sour! One of the suspects is lying.

clue_awal.A1: Sugar is only kept in the kitchen. If sugar was used, the sabotage must have happened in the Kitchen.

pengakuan.P1: I didn't go to the porch at all tonight.
pengakuan.P2: I didn't touch the salt. My nails were just painted.
pengakuan.P3: I didn't take any sugar. My coffee was bitter tonight.
pengakuan.P4: I didn't touch the soy sauce bottle, I swear on my followers.
pengakuan.P5: I didn't go into Mother's bedroom tonight.

benda.tk_meja: There's a round pot mark on the porch table. The rendang pot cooled here from 5:00 p.m. until Grandma took it in.
benda.dp_laci: In the spice drawer, the packet of salt is still taped shut. It hasn't been opened at all.
benda.dp_kulkas: The soy sauce bottle in the fridge door is still sealed. The other one ran out last week.
benda.rk_meja: Every chili powder sachet from the meatball vendor is still on the desk, untouched. Not one has been opened.
benda.kn_ranjang: The sheets and the bedroom floor are clean. No smell of rendang at all; the pot never came in here.
benda.dp_kompor: The stove has been cold since the afternoon. The rendang pot clearly didn't come back to the kitchen before 9:00 p.m.
benda.rt_meja: The coffee table is covered with plates of cake for the savings-club guests. The rendang pot never stopped by the living room.
benda.rk_papan: Written on the board: "Neighborhood meeting 6:00–9:00 p.m." The Study was full of men, and there was no pot here.
benda.tk_kursi: A folding fan with a floral pattern was left on the rattan chair. It smells like vinegar.
benda.tk_sampah: The porch bin is full of starfruit leaves. A lot of starfruit leaves.
benda.tk_kandang: Mr. Joko's chickens stare at you. They won't talk.
benda.dp_toples: The cracker jar is full. There's folded money at the bottom, but that's Mbok Sri's business.
benda.dp_wastafel: The sink is clean. The dish sponge is as thin as a family secret.
benda.kn_weker: The alarm clock is set for 4:00 a.m. Grandma wants to hit the market before the contest.
benda.rk_komputer: The screen shows the neighborhood meeting slides: "Independence Day Contest Budget". Boring, but clean.
benda.rt_foto: A photo of Grandma holding last year's rendang trophy. Her smile is full of confidence.

en.teks_kosong_bawaan: You check it carefully, but nothing looks suspicious.
penjelasan: The liar is always the culprit. So if someone is the culprit, their statement must be false: Mrs. Wati was on the porch, Aunt Lia used salt, Dimas used sugar, Raka used soy sauce, Uncle Benny was in Grandma's bedroom.
The rendang pot was cooling on the porch table: the sabotage happened on the Porch.
The salt, soy sauce, and chili powder were untouched. Sugar could only be used in the kitchen. What's left: vinegar.
Vinegar on the porch fits only one liar: Mrs. Wati, who claimed she never went to the porch.
en.komentar_nenek: Wati, if you want to win the contest, cook something tasty. Don't add vinegar to Grandma's rendang.
